declarations.description:
WebDropzone - Renderer subclass of `DropzoneEngine`.

Inherits the file state, validation, upload pipeline, event emission,
reorder timers, persisted-state load/save, and overall-progress data
methods from `DropzoneEngine`. This class adds the DOM rendering layer
(popover, drag overlay, satellite mounting, click/keydown wiring) and
overrides the protected hooks declared on the base so core mutations
write back into the DOM.
declarations.name: WebDropzone

members.name: popoverHandle
members.description:
Core `createPopover()` handle of the open popover (positioning, the
overlay tree's outside click / Escape); null while it is closed.

members.name: popoverResizeObserver
members.description:
ResizeObserver watching the popover for user-driven resize. Saves
the resulting dimensions to persisted state. Disconnected in
closePopover so it doesn't leak past popover lifetime.

members.name: popoverSaveTimer
members.description:
Debounce handle for the resize → save flow. ResizeObserver fires on
every drag tick; we only want to persist the final dimension.

members.name: popoverPhoneQuery
members.description: The phone-line query while the popover is open (a sheet below it, un-anchored).

members.name: popoverIsSheet
members.description: Whether the open popover is presented as a phone sheet (null while closed).

members.name: popoverAnchoredSize
members.description: The anchored panel's inline width / height (persisted or user-resized), put away while it is a sheet.

members.name: popoverReturnFocus
members.description: What had focus when the popover opened — the close button gives focus back to it.

members.name: showAllList
members.description:
When true, the maxVisibleFileCount cap is ignored and all files are
rendered. Toggled by the "Show N more" / "Show less" button at the
end of the list (or the "+N" badge in badges mode). Reset on clear().

members.name: satelliteListEl
members.description:
The `<web-dropzone-list>` satellite mounted by `mountSatellites()`.
Used as a popover anchor in the satellite-rolling path (the actual
`.dz__file-list--rolling` element lives in the satellite's shadow
root and isn't reachable from `getPopoverAnchor`). Null when the
in-class renderer is in use.

members.name: satellitePickerEl
members.description:
The `<web-dropzone-picker>` satellite mounted by `mountSatellites()`.
Owns the hidden file input on the satellite path (so `inputEl` is null
there) — the popover's "Add more" asks it to open the dialog.

members.name: fileRowElements
members.description:
Cache of element-returning `renderFileItemCallback` outputs, keyed by
file id. When present for a file, `patchFileRow` skips the re-render
path and dispatches a `file-row-update` event on the cached element
instead — preserving listeners and DOM identity across state ticks.
Pruned in `renderFileList` (files no longer visible) and in
`removeFile`.

members.name: isEngineEventWiringActive
members.description:
Whether `onEngineEvent` reacts. On between `attachEventListeners` and
`detachEventListeners` (off during an `updateConfig` re-render and
after destroy), mirroring the old substrate-listener lifetime.

members.name: isActive
members.description:
Whether the page-level wiring is live — the overlay's document / window
listeners and an open popover's positioning + outside-click / Escape
listeners. Built active; the element turns it off while detached
(`deactivate()` on disconnect, `activate()` on reconnect) so a DOM move
keeps the files, uploads and popover without leaking listeners.

members.name: activate
members.description: Reconnect: restore the page-level wiring `deactivate()` stopped.

members.name: deactivate
members.description:
Disconnect: stop the page-level wiring; files, uploads and the popover
(open state + DOM) are kept for `activate()`.

members.name: shouldUseSatelliteRendering
members.description:
Convenience-form rendering paths that decompose cleanly into a
`<web-dropzone-picker>` + `<web-dropzone-list>` pair.

Gated by renderMode (hard switch — see DropzoneRenderMode):
  - 'bulk' (default)  → satellite path; render callbacks IGNORED.
  - 'structural'      → in-class render path so render callbacks
                        (`renderFileItemCallback`, etc.) take effect.
  - 'headless'        → render() short-circuits before reaching us.

Notes on the satellite path:
 - `popover` is satellite — the list satellite renders the summary
   anchor and dispatches `summary-activate`. The popover wrapper
   (Floating UI + resize + persistence) stays in-class and opens on
   that event via the bridge in `mountSatellites`.
 - `files-inside` is satellite — the picker satellite gets
   `inside="true"`, includes a `<slot>` inside its card, and the
   list satellite is mounted as the picker's light-DOM child with
   `nested="true"` so it uses the `.dz__files-inside--*` class
   family.

members.name: isStructuralMode
members.description: True only when consumer-provided render callbacks should be honored.

members.name: mountSatellites
members.description:
Build + bind the satellite picker / list elements for the convenience
form. Called from `render()` after `innerHTML` has populated the
container shell. Each satellite is constructed imperatively so
`bindToStore` can run BEFORE `connectedCallback` fires — that way
the satellite sees `programmaticStoreEl` on its first connect and
never logs the "store not found" warning.

members.name: disabledAttr
members.description:
` disabled` for every button the store renders while it is disabled
(`disabled` or a disabled `<fieldset>`): native semantics, core SPEC
§6.4 — no interaction, not focusable. Calls from code still work.

members.name: isAddBlocked
members.description: The user can't add files: `disabled` (input or fieldset) or `readonly`.

members.name: selectorControlAttrs
members.description:
Native semantics for the selector's controls (core SPEC §6.4): disabled
= `disabled` (no interaction, not focusable); read-only = still focusable,
marked `aria-disabled` (it adds nothing — the click handler refuses it).
A button that also opens the file popover stays a plain button under
read-only (`isListTrigger`): the files can still be looked at.

members.name: isSelectorListTrigger
members.description: Button / minimal + popover with files: the selector button opens the list.

members.name: renderCardContent
members.description:
Render the inner content of the card selector. Honors
`renderPromptCallback` if provided.

members.name: applyReorderToRenderer
members.description:
Renderer-side reorder hook. Called from `DropzoneEngine.scheduleReorder`'s
timer when a file's reorder window elapses. Flips the inline row's
`data-reorder-bucket`, re-sorts the popover tbody if open, and
re-renders the cap-bounded list so any newly-eligible row drops out
of the visible window (and the next hidden file slides up).

members.name: renderOverallProgressArea
members.description:
Empty strip below the inline list. Populated by `updateOverallProgress`
whenever any file is uploading / complete / error, and emptied (which
collapses it via `:empty`) when there's no upload activity to report.

members.name: htmlToElement
members.description:
Parse an HTML string into a single root element. Uses <template> so
almost any tag (including <tr>) can be parsed without a wrapping
context.

members.name: bindListRemoveHandlers
members.description:
Attach the main-list remove + row-action click handlers within a
subtree. Element-returning row callbacks (see `fileRowElements`)
cause this to be called multiple times against the SAME buttons
across re-renders — without the `data-dz-bound-*` marker, each
click would fire N handlers (one per render), which for retry
actions kicks off parallel uploads.

members.name: bindPopoverRemoveHandlers
members.description:
Attach the popover remove-button click handler. Behaves like the main
list, additionally refreshing the popover body (so the row visibly
disappears) and closing the popover when the last file is removed.

Important: `removeFile` alone only updates `this.files` and re-renders
the inline list — it doesn't touch the popover. So this handler is
the ONE place responsible for keeping the popover's table in sync
after a per-row X click.

members.name: handleUserRemoveClick
members.description:
Row ✕ click — remove the file, confirmed through
`beforeFilesRemoveCallback`. A running upload is cancelled first (its
handler gets the signal and up to `cancel-timeout`), then the file is
removed. Cancelling without removing is the row's ⊘ Cancel button.

members.name: hasUploadHandler
members.description: The file has an upload handler (store-level or per-file, Mode B).

members.name: patchFileRow
members.description:
Patch a single file row in-place — in the main list (or files-inside
container) and in the open popover, if any. Hot path on every upload
tick, so we surgically update the bar fill / progress text / status
pill instead of rebuilding the row's DOM. Otherwise the X remove
button would be destroyed and re-created on every tick and clicks
would be swallowed (same problem the overall progress strip had).

Custom renderers (renderFileItemCallback) opt out of in-place
patching — we can't introspect their DOM shape, so we fall back to
replaceWith and let the consumer eat the click-flicker tradeoff.

members.name: patchPopoverRowInPlace
members.description:
In-place row patch for the popover. Updates the progress bar fill,
progress text, status pill (text + modifier class), uploading-animation
class on the row, and the remove button's hidden state. Everything
else — icon, filename, size, the remove button itself — stays put so
clicks land cleanly.

members.name: reorderPopoverRows
members.description:
Resync the popover tbody's row order against getOrderedFiles(). Only
called when a row crosses the complete-incomplete boundary (and the
reorder toggle is on), so this isn't a hot path. Appending an element
already in the DOM moves it in place, so a stable single pass over
the desired order is sufficient.

members.name: swapPreviewIcon
members.description: One-shot icon-slot → `` swap for the badges / detailed inline rows when a file's `previewUrl` lands asynchronously. No-op when the slot is absent (icon part disabled via `item-controls`), already an ``, or the preview hasn't resolved yet. Grid has its own placeholder→img path.

members.name: patchInlineRowInPlace
members.description: In-place row patch for inline lists (list / detailed / grid / badges). Most of these modes don't render progress, so the patch is light: - badges: status modifier class + icon→img swap on previewUrl - detailed: icon→img swap on previewUrl (when show-thumbnails) - grid: swap the placeholder out for an when previewUrl arrives (one-shot transition) - all: sync the remove button's hidden state

members.name: syncRemoveButtonHiddenState
members.description:
Toggle the `--hidden` modifier on a per-row remove button plus the
matching aria/tabindex attrs. Shared across all the patcher
variants so the rules for hiding stay in one place.

members.name: renderFileItemForList
members.description:
Like `renderFileItem(file, i, false)` but preserves an
HTMLElement return from `renderFileItemCallback`. The popover and
the rolling path keep using `renderFileItem` (string-only) because
those layouts don't benefit from element identity — they re-render
the front row / table-row anyway.

members.name: getFrontFile
members.description:
Pick the file currently occupying the "front" slot in the rolling
appearance. Priority: first uploading → first pending → first
paused/error/cancelled (needs attention) → last completed (so the
user sees the result for a beat before the slot empties). Returns
null only when `this.files` is empty.

members.name: renderRollingList
members.description:
Render the rolling appearance — a stable container that acts as the
popover anchor. Inside, the "current" front-file row overlaps with
any outgoing one in the same grid cell so the rotation keyframes
(slide-in / horizontal / vertical) can play simultaneously without
shifting the container. The queue button floats in the container's
top-right corner as a count badge.

Same call serves both first render and front-changed re-render —
previousCurrent is detected from the DOM. When the front file is
unchanged we leave the inner row alone (patchInlineRowInPlace
handles per-tick progress / status churn elsewhere) and just refresh
the queue count.

members.name: applyRollingSlots
members.description:
Apply the rolling file-info + progress callbacks (if set) into the
row inside `currentEl`. The row template's existing
`.dz__file-item-name` span hosts the file-info slot; the
`.dz__file-item-progress` block hosts the progress slot. Each is
routed through the shared memoizer so cached element returns
(e.g. WAAPI spinners) survive across ticks.

When a callback isn't set or returns null, the corresponding slot
keeps the polished default contents that `renderListItem` already
generated — no DOM write.

members.name: updateRollingQueueButton
members.description:
Ensure the rolling queue badge exists inside `targetEl` and reflects
the current file count. Created once and reused across re-renders so
its click handler isn't repeatedly rebound (and so the badge doesn't
flicker during a front-file swap).

members.name: getVisibleFiles
members.description:
Slice `files` to the visible window. When `maxVisibleFileCount` is 0/unset,
or `showAllList` is true, the full selection is returned. Otherwise only
the first `maxVisibleFileCount` files are rendered and the rest are hidden
behind the "Show N more" toggle.

members.name: renderToggleButton
members.description:
Render the trailing "Show N more" / "Show less" toggle. The visual
differs by list appearance:
  - badges       — compact pill matching the badge frame ("+5" / "−")
  - everything else — full-width text button under the list
Returns "" when no toggle is needed (no cap, or selection fits).

members.name: bindToggleHandler
members.description:
Attach the "Show more / Show less" click handler within a subtree.
Only used by the inline list — the popover scrolls internally, so its
body is never sliced.

members.name: shouldShowThumbnails
members.description:
Resolve the "use thumbnails" flag with per-mode auto-default. The grid
appearance kept image previews even before the attribute existed, so
leaving show-thumbnails unset there still produces thumbnails. Every
other appearance defaults to icons so adding the attribute to the family
doesn't quietly change the look of existing badge / detailed lists.

members.name: deriveLegacyDisplayMode
members.description: Reverse-map listAppearance → DisplayMode for backward-compatible callbacks.

members.name: isFileUserRemovable
members.description:
Whether the remove button should be rendered as interactive for this
file. Returns `false` when the file finished uploading AND the caller
opted out of allowing user-driven deletion of completed files; in that
case the renderers emit the button anyway (so column / cell widths
stay reserved) but stamp a `--hidden` modifier that drops it from the
tab order and hides it via `visibility: hidden`.

members.name: handleUserActionClick
members.description:
Row action click (see `actionForStatus`) — uploading→pauseFile,
paused→resumeFile, error / cancelled→retryFile. Other statuses are
no-ops (the button is rendered inert via `--hidden`).

members.name: rowOpts
members.description:
Pack per-row knobs for the shared template module. The shared module
has no view of the store's config — `isReorderEligible` /
`isFileUserRemovable` / `shouldShowThumbnails` live here because they
read config-driven state (reorder mode, post-upload deletion flag,
thumbnail policy per appearance). We compute the booleans here and
hand them to the template as plain data.

members.name: renderSummaryIcon
members.description:
Render the icon shown in the popover-summary line. Paperclip when the
selection hasn't seen any upload activity yet (still purely pending),
otherwise the aggregate status icon — same Lucide glyph + colour rules
as the per-row status pill, so the summary reads as "uploading /
paused / errored / done" at a glance even when the popover is closed.

members.name: patchSummaryIcon
members.description:
Per-tick patch for the summary-line icon. Called from
updateOverallProgress so the icon swaps from paperclip → spinner →
check / error / pause without rebuilding the summary line (which
would tear down its click handler).

members.name: updateSelectorBadge
members.description:
Patch the count badge on the active selector (button or minimal) in
place. Each selector renders its badge conditionally inside
renderSelector() at component-build time (count = 0 means no badge in
the DOM), so the badge has to be created / removed / updated on every
files change rather than re-rendering the whole selector (which would
trash the hidden <input> and its listeners).

members.name: getFileCountLabel
members.description:
Build the popover's file-count label ("3 files", "1 file"). Used in the
header in place of a static "Selected Files" title.

members.name: getLimitsHint
members.description:
Compose a one-liner restating accept / max-size / max-files. Shown under
the header in the popover where the card's hint isn't visible. Falls back
to the caller-configured `labels.hint` when set; otherwise auto-derived from
validation config.

members.name: getFooterContent
members.description:
Footer content for the popover — overall totals (count + total size),
with an aggregate progress strip above when any upload is in flight or
already finished. Returns "" when there are no files (the :empty CSS
selector then hides the footer entirely).

members.name: refreshPopoverFooter
members.description:
In-place refresh of the popover footer. The overall progress strip is
delegated to refreshOverallProgress (which preserves action buttons
across ticks); the totals row is patched span-by-span. `includeTotals`
lets the hot path (progress ticks) skip the totals work, since per-file
size doesn't change mid-upload.

members.name: renderOverallProgressMarkup
members.description:
Shared HTML for the aggregate progress strip — bar + a single stats line
showing completed/total counts, bytes uploaded vs. total, and percent.
Used both inline (under the file list) and inside the popover footer.
When any file is in the 'error' state, a "Retry all" button appears
between the stats and the percent (mirrors FluentUI's overallFooter).

members.name: renderOverallCountsInner
members.description:
Inner HTML of the counts line — extracted so per-tick patching can
refresh just this span without disturbing the surrounding action
buttons.

members.name: renderOverallActions
members.description:
Bulk-action buttons rendered between the counts and the percent. Each
gates on a state crossing zero (Pause all when something's uploading,
Resume all when something's paused, Retry all when something errored).
Returns "" when no actions apply.

members.name: overallActionsSignature
members.description:
Single-character signature of which action buttons are currently
showing. Stored on the container's dataset; per-tick refreshes only
rebuild the buttons when this signature actually changes. Otherwise
the buttons stay put across ticks — without this, every progress
update would destroy and re-create them, making them unclickable.

members.name: bindOverallProgressHandlers
members.description:
Attach the "Retry all" click handler within a subtree. Used everywhere
the overall progress markup is rendered: the inline strip's update path,
the initial popover render, and the popover's footer refresh.

members.name: updateOverallProgress
members.description:
Refresh the inline aggregate progress strip below the file list. Cleared
to empty (which collapses via `:empty`) when there's no activity to
report; otherwise renders the shared bar+stats markup.

members.name: refreshOverallProgress
members.description:
Refresh an overall-progress container in place. Patches the bar fill /
counts / percent on every call (cheap, no event handlers to thrash);
only rebuilds the inner DOM when the structure is missing or when the
action-button set changes. Used by both the inline strip and the
popover footer's embedded strip.

members.name: closePopover
members.description:
Close the popover — from code, the trigger, or the overlay tree
(outside click / Escape: `onClose`). Idempotent.

members.name: flushPopoverSize
members.description:
Read the popover's current size from its computed style and persist
it. Called from the ResizeObserver's debounced tick and from the
flush path in closePopover so a late close doesn't drop the final
dimension.

members.name: isPopoverSheet
members.description: Whether the open popover is a phone sheet (below the 600px line, css/sheet.css).

members.name: applyPopoverPresentation
members.description:
Phone sheet or anchored panel: a sheet is un-anchored (the sheet CSS places
it) and puts the panel's inline size (persisted / user-resized) away; back
above the line the anchored panel gets it again. Detached (moved) dropzones
stay un-anchored until `activate()`.

members.name: getPopoverAnchor
members.description:
Resolve the popover's anchor element. The current rendering surface
exposes a `.dz__summary-line` when selectorAppearance='card' (since the
summary line is the click trigger), and falls back to the inline
selector button (button or minimal modes) where the selector itself is
the click trigger.

members.name: onEngineEvent
members.description:
Renderer-side reactions to engine happenings — called by the engine's
`notify` BEFORE the event is emitted, so the DOM is current when
consumers' listeners run. Inactive between `detachEventListeners` and
`attachEventListeners` (an `updateConfig` re-render, destroy).

members.name: onConfigApplied
members.description: A config re-render (`updateConfig`) refreshes the same surfaces as `change`.

members.name: refreshAggregateSurfaces
members.description:
Summary line, selector badge, overall progress strip and the open
popover all depend on aggregate state — refreshed on every selection
change (add / remove / clear) and after a config re-render.

declarations.name: labelsConverter
declarations.description:
`labels` input: core `toObject()` with the labels shape check — a partial
`DropzoneLabels` object (property), or the same as a JSON attribute
(`labels='{"cancelFile":"Zrušit {name}"}'`). Absent / `undefined` → the
built-in English. A malformed attribute or a non-object / non-string value is
refused (core's rule: warning, `input-rejected`, previous value kept). Merged
per key at lookup time.

declarations.name: subscribePageFileDrag
declarations.description:
Subscribe to page-wide file drags. The listener is NOT called with the
current state on subscribe — read isPageFileDragActive for that.
Returns the unsubscribe function (idempotent).

declarations.name: isPageFileDragActive
declarations.description: True while a file drag is in progress over the page (only tracked while someone is subscribed).

declarations.name: ARMED_STATE
declarations.description: The host attribute / custom state that marks an armed drop target.

declarations.name: applyArmedState
declarations.description:
Expose the armed state on a host the way core exposes `ready`: the `armed`
attribute (the portable CSS hook, `:host([armed])`) plus `:state(armed)`
when the engine has CustomStateSet.

declarations.name: PHONE_MEDIA_QUERY
declarations.description:
The phone line of the overlay panels (responsive-overlay.md D-RO-3 = A, 600px).
Below it the indicator drawer and the compact popover are full-screen sheets —
drawn by `css/sheet.css` (`@media (max-width: 600px)`, the same literal); the
popover reads this query to un-anchor itself so the sheet CSS places it.

declarations.name: getPhoneMediaQuery
declarations.description: The phone-line media query list, or `null` without `matchMedia` (SSR, old jsdom).

declarations.name: patchProgressFill
declarations.description:
Set the progress-bar fill's width. Idempotent — assigning the same
percent twice is cheap (the browser short-circuits a no-op style write).

declarations.name: patchProgressText
declarations.description:
Set the progress-text node's content — the rounded percent, or
"Cancelling…" while a cancel is pending (`progressLabel`). Used by
list / detailed / popover where a label sits next to the bar; grid omits
the text and only patches the fill.

declarations.name: patchStatusIcon
declarations.description:
Swap the status-icon slot's class modifier, glyph, and a11y labels when
the file's status changes. Gated on `dataset.status` so a 50 ms upload
tick with no status change is a no-op (avoids re-injecting SVG strings
each frame).

declarations.name: patchRemoveButton
declarations.description:
Show / hide a row's remove button (`removable` false: the `--hidden`
modifier, out of the tab order, hidden from AT). The button stays in the
DOM so the row's layout doesn't shift.

declarations.name: patchCancelButton
declarations.description:
In-place patch the per-row Cancel button: `--hidden` (inert) when there is
nothing to cancel, disabled while `cancelling` or while the store is disabled.

declarations.name: patchActionButton
declarations.description:
In-place patch the per-row action button (pause / resume / retry) as the
file's status transitions. Slot stays in the DOM at all times so column
widths don't shift across status changes; this function toggles the
`--hidden` modifier and swaps the glyph + a11y attributes when the
applicable action changes. Gated on `dataset.rowAction` so the live
button isn't disrupted while a user click is in flight between ticks.

declarations.name: syncRowButtonsDisabled
declarations.description:
Re-sync a kept row's action / cancel / remove buttons with the store's
disabled state (a row that survives a config re-render — the rolling front
row). Disabled store → all three `disabled` (core SPEC §6.4); cancel /
remove also stay disabled while the file is `cancelling`.

declarations.name: ACTION_LABEL_KEYS
declarations.default: { pause: 'pauseFile', resume: 'resumeFile', retry: 'retryFile' } as const satisfies Record<RowAction, string>
declarations.description: The label key of a row action button (aria-label / tooltip, `{name}` = file).

declarations.name: INLINE_LOADER
declarations.description:
The tiny loader inside one item (a row's status pill, the summary icon): the
shared loader contract drawn by CSS only (`.dz__loader--inline`, the
`--dz-loader-inline-size` token) — no render hook, no `role="status"`; the
item carries `aria-busy` instead. Big loading states go through core
`renderLoader()` (the indicator chip).

declarations.name: statusGlyph
declarations.description: A status glyph — the inline loader while uploading, the Lucide icon otherwise.

declarations.name: busyAttr
declarations.description: `aria-busy` for a row root while its file uploads.

declarations.name: renderStatusPill
declarations.description: Status pill — glyph + the status name as tooltip / accessible name (`labels`).

declarations.name: isCancelOffered
declarations.description:
Whether a row offers Cancel: uploading / paused (and `cancelling`, shown
disabled), plus queued files when an upload handler will run them.

declarations.name: renderCancelButton
declarations.description:
Per-row Cancel (⊘) button. Always in the DOM (the slot stays reserved —
`--hidden` when there is nothing to cancel); disabled while `cancelling`.
`baseClass` is the appearance's action-button class, so it shares that
button's styling; `data-dz-action="cancel"` identifies it.

declarations.name: renderRemoveButton
declarations.description:
Per-row Remove (✕) button — always rendered; `--hidden` (layout kept) when
the file isn't user-removable, disabled while `cancelling`. A `remove-icon`
replaces the CSS-masked glyph (`data-custom-icon` switches the mask off).

declarations.name: renderPlaceholderInner
declarations.description: Inner content for the icon slot — `` when thumbnail mode is on and the file already has a preview URL, else the file-type emoji.

declarations.name: renderRowActionButton
declarations.description:
Per-row action button (pause / resume / retry — see `actionForStatus`).
The slot is ALWAYS in the DOM so column widths stay reserved as state
transitions. When there's no applicable action (pending / complete) the
`--hidden` modifier hides the button visually and drops it from the tab
order.

declarations.name: progressLabel
declarations.description:
Text next to a row's progress bar: the percent, or "Cancelling…" while a
cancel waits for the upload handler to settle.

declarations.name: removeButtonAttrs
declarations.description:
Attribute block for the always-rendered remove button. Hidden buttons
stay in the DOM (layout reserved) but are inert.

declarations.name: resolveStoreElement
declarations.description:
Look up the `<web-dropzone>` element a satellite binds to via its `for=`
attribute. Returns null if the element is missing or isn't a
`<web-dropzone>` (e.g. `for="some-div"`). Does NOT wait for the store to
be upgraded or initialized — callers should pair this with
`whenStoreReady`, which handles both races.

Note: we check by `tagName` rather than duck-typing on `controller` because
the store custom element may not have upgraded yet (satellites can
register before `<web-dropzone>` does — see index.ts).

declarations.name: whenStoreReady
declarations.description:
Resolve a store's controller (the satellite-side twin of `storeEl.controller`), waiting if the
store hasn't upgraded or built yet. Calls `onResolved` exactly once.
Returns a teardown function that cancels the wait if the satellite is
disconnected before resolution.

Race handling: a satellite can connect before the store does — either
because the store hasn't upgraded yet (custom element registration
order) or because its build hasn't run yet. We listen for the store's
internal build signal (`STORE_BUILD_EVENT`, every build — core's public

members.name: renderScheduler
members.description:
Coalesces structural re-render requests within the same microtask.
Adding N files at once dispatches N × file-add plus one change —
without coalescing we'd rebuild the list N+1 times (and destroy the
row a user might be mid-click on). With it: one rebuild per burst.

slots (body / file-info / progress). Lets cached WAAPI spinners
survive across ticks the same way the indicator satellite does.

members.name: showAll
members.description:
When `max-visible-file-count` is in effect and the queue exceeds it, the
list collapses to the first N rows + a "Show N more" toggle. Click
flips this flag and re-renders; further structural events (add /
remove / clear) leave it sticky so the user's preference survives
the next burst. Reset to false on a full clear in the change handler.

members.name: renderShowMoreToggle
members.description:
Render the trailing "Show N more" / "Show less" toggle when the
`max-visible-file-count` cap is in effect and the queue exceeds it.
Mirrors the in-class renderer's `renderToggleButton` — badges
surface uses a pill-shaped variant to fit the badge frame; the
other inline appearances use a full-width text button.

members.name: bindToggleHandler
members.description:
Bind the toggle button's click handler (only present when the
max-visible cap is active and over).

members.name: renderSummary
members.description:
Render a single summary line ("{count} files · {size}") that acts as
the click target for the popover. The actual popover wrapper is
external to this satellite — the convenience form's `<web-dropzone>`
renders it in-class, and standalone consumers wire any UI they want
by listening for `summary-activate` (bubbles, not composed) or setting
its `onSummaryActivate` twin.

The summary subtree is re-rendered on every store change. That's
cheap (one line of DOM) and avoids the per-tick patching dance the
in-class summary does — there's no nested resize / focus state to
preserve here, just the icon + text.

every control this list renders is `disabled` — no interaction, not

members.description: `allow-uploaded-file-removal="false"` hides the remove button on completed rows (layout kept).

members.description: Row belongs in the "complete" reorder bucket (`sink-completed`, delay elapsed).

members.name: orderForReorder
members.description: Stable sort: rows in the "complete" reorder bucket last.

members.description:

flip the row's bucket so the CSS `order` moves it. With a
`max-visible-file-count` cap the visible window changes too, so re-render.

members.description:
Resolve the thumbnail flag with the same per-appearance auto-default as
`WebDropzone.shouldShowThumbnails`: `show-thumbnails` (store config
`isThumbnailsShown`) wins when set; otherwise only `grid` defaults
to thumbnails. Kept in sync so the satellite list renders image previews
for `list-appearance="badges" show-thumbnails` just like the built-in form.

members.name: getFrontFile
members.description:
Pick the file currently occupying the "front" slot. Priority order:
first uploading → first pending → first paused/error/cancelled
(needs attention) → last completed (so the slot doesn't go empty the
instant a final upload hits 100%). Returns null only when `files`
is empty.

members.name: resolveRollingRotation
members.description:
Resolve the rolling rotation mode from the store's config. The
satellite doesn't take its own `rolling-rotation` attribute — the
store is the single source of truth (matches the in-class renderer's
behavior). Falls back to 'slide-in' which is the cheapest variant.

members.name: renderRolling
members.description:
Render the rolling block. Same call serves first-render and front-
changed re-render — `previousCurrent` is detected from the DOM. When
the front file hasn't shifted, the existing slot is left in place and
we just refresh the queue count + any callback-driven slot content
(tick patching is handled by `patchRow` elsewhere).

members.name: applyRollingSlots
members.description:
Apply the rolling file-info + progress callbacks (if set) into the
row inside `currentEl`. The list-item template's `.dz__file-item-name`
span hosts the file-info slot; `.dz__file-item-progress` hosts the
progress slot. Routed through the shared memoizer so cached element
returns (e.g. WAAPI spinners) survive across ticks.

members.name: updateRollingQueueButton
members.description:
Ensure the rolling queue badge exists inside `wrapper` and reflects
the current file count. Created once and reused across re-renders so
its click handler isn't repeatedly rebound (and so the badge doesn't
flicker during a front-file swap). On click, dispatches a
`queue-open` event (core `emit()`, `onQueueOpen` twin; bubbles, not composed) — popover wiring
happens externally (convenience form listens; standalone users wire
their own).

members.name: patchPreview
members.description: One-shot icon-slot → `` swap when a file's `previewUrl` lands asynchronously (store emits `file-update`). members.name: responsive
members.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). members.name: #customStyles
members.description: Core's custom-CSS handle (page layer + instance layer), made on the first build.

members.name: #unsubscribePageDrag
members.description: Unsubscribe from the shared page-drag tracker (set while `highlight-on-page-drag` is live).

members.name: #stateStore
members.description:
Persisted UI state (core SPEC §12.17, rulebook C-CA-17): one handle on
the host — `storage-key` + `loadStateCallback` / `saveStateCallback`,
default localStorage `km-state:web-dropzone:<key>`. Made here (not in
the store) so it outlives a rebuild; injected through the engine host.

members.name: #engineHost
members.default: { element: this, stateStore: this.#stateStore, getController: () => this.controller, notify: (name, detail) => { // Re-stamp the form value before listeners run, so a `change` // handler reading the form sees the new selection. if (name === 'change') this.#syncFormValue(); this.emit(name, detail as never); } }

members.name: createController
members.description:
The public facade (`el.controller`): built once, delegates to the live
store (flushing pending input writes first), so it survives rebuilds.
Satellites bind through it too.

members.name: formResetCallback
members.description:
Called by the browser when the surrounding <form> is reset. Clears the
dropzone selection so the component participates in the standard reset.

members.name: disabledChanged
members.description:
Core reports a flip of the effective disabled state — the `disabled`
input OR an ancestor `<fieldset disabled>` (`isEffectivelyDisabled`).
`el.isDisabled` keeps the author's value, like a native control.

members.name: isArmed
members.description:
True while the dropzone is armed (`highlight-on-page-drag` + files are
dragged over the page + it accepts drops). Mirrors the `armed` attribute
/ `:state(armed)`.

members.name: reinit
members.description: Structural change (or first connect): rebuild the store from scratch.

members.name: #applyCustomStyles
members.description:
Custom CSS (core usage "Style injection", rulebook C-CA-15): the page
layer `window.components['web-dropzone'].customStyles` /
`.getCustomStylesCallback(ctx)`, then this instance's `customStyles` /
`getCustomStylesCallback`. One handle, made on the first build, refreshed
per build.

members.name: update
members.description:
In-place change: patch the live store via `updateConfig`. A change to any
of the four mode-determining inputs can flip the operating mode, which the
store can't apply in place — detect that and do a full rebuild instead
(matching the pre-core behaviour, where a mode flip reset the selection).

members.name: connect
members.description:
Activate: (re)start the store's page-level wiring. The store itself is
built once by `reinit()` and survives a DOM move — files, in-flight
uploads and popover state are kept (decision D1). Only a store torn down
by a removal (`removedCallback`) is rebuilt here, fresh and empty. The
FOUC hook is core's `ready` attribute / `:state(ready)`.

members.name: disconnect
members.description:
Deactivate: stop the store's document / window listeners and popover
positioning. The store, its files and uploads are kept — a DOM move
reconnects without a rebuild; `destroy()` tears it down.

members.name: removedCallback
members.description:
Removed from the page (still detached one frame after `disconnect()` —
a DOM move never gets here). Unless `keep-alive-when-removed`:
cancel every upload by the cancel rule (handlers get their signal and
up to `cancel-timeout`; no `beforeFilesCancelCallback` — there is no UI
to veto from) and then destroy the store. Re-adding the element after
that builds a fresh, empty store (`connect()`; `ready` does not fire
again — it is a once-per-element core event); re-adding it while the
cancels are still settling keeps the store (its uploads cancelled).

members.name: destroyCallback
members.description:
`el.destroy()` (core) — final teardown, immediate: every running upload
handler gets its AbortSignal at once (no `cancel-timeout` grace, no
events after — the app asked for it; contrast `removedCallback`, which
cancels by the cancel rule first). Destroys the store and clears the
form value; the element is inert afterwards.

members.name: #syncPageDrag
members.description:
Join / leave the shared page-drag tracker per `highlight-on-page-drag`
and the connection state (one page listener set for every instance),
then re-derive the armed state.

events.name: file-upload
events.description: `uploadFileCallback` resolved for a file. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileUpload(detail)`.

events.name: file-delete
events.description: SERVER state: a removed file had server-side state (upload completed, or metadata stashed via `setMetadata`) — fires right after its `file-remove`; wire your server DELETE here. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileDelete(detail)`.

events.name: file-cancel
events.description: A cancel finished. `detail`: `{ file, result: 'cancelled' | 'timeout-error' | 'timeout-remove', uploadedBytes, metadata }`. Server-side cleanup of a partial upload is the app's job. Twin: `onFileCancel(detail)`.

events.name: file-progress
events.description: A file's progress changed. `detail`: `{ id, progress, status, file }`. Twin: `onFileProgress(detail)`.

events.name: file-status-change
events.description: A file's status transitioned. `detail`: `{ id, oldStatus, newStatus, file }`. Twin: `onFileStatusChange(detail)`.

events.name: file-update
events.description: A file field other than progress / status changed (preview generated, upload result merged). `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileUpdate(detail)`.

events.name: overlay-enter
events.description: A drag entered the drag overlay (`overlay-target`). `detail`: `{ overlayElement }`. Twin: `onOverlayEnter(detail)`.

events.name: overlay-leave
events.description: A drag left the drag overlay. `detail`: `{ overlayElement }`. Twin: `onOverlayLeave(detail)`.

events.name: ready
events.description: Core lifecycle event: fired ONCE, after the first build (the store is live, `el.controller` works). A later rebuild (mode flip) or a DOM move does not fire it again. The host gets the `ready` attribute and `:state(ready)`; `await el.whenReady()` is the promise form. Hold the first build with the `defer` attribute and `release()`. `detail`: `controller` / `element`. Twin: `onReady(detail)`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.
